title: Every Wonder Horizon Promo
source_claim: 12 curated MagicFit-rendered refined deep-dive clips; distinct from the All Horizons teaser

scene_narration.caption: Every Wonder starts when split screens start slowing the table.
scene_narration.narration: Every Wonder Horizon starts with the real table problem: split devices, split notes, and a scene that should already be moving.

scene_narration.caption: NEXUS-PAN recovers session state when players reconnect.
scene_narration.narration: NEXUS-PAN keeps reconnects calm. Players return with visible state, conflict status, and a clean handoff.

scene_narration.caption: ALICE compares runner choices before they become table problems.
scene_narration.narration: ALICE turns build advice into explainable tradeoffs: role fit, survivability, legality, and cost.

scene_narration.caption: KARMA FORGE previews house-rule impact before approval.
scene_narration.narration: KARMA FORGE makes house rules inspectable. The GM sees impact before the table commits.

scene_narration.caption: JACKPOINT turns table events into clean dossiers.
scene_narration.narration: JACKPOINT turns table events into dossiers, briefings, recaps, and player-safe handouts.

scene_narration.caption: RUNSITE makes mission spaces readable before contact.
scene_narration.narration: RUNSITE opens the site before the run starts: routes, hotspots, layers, and GM-only context.

scene_narration.caption: RUNBOOK PRESS shapes campaign material into books.
scene_narration.narration: RUNBOOK PRESS turns campaign material into structured guides, season books, and handoff-ready exports.

scene_narration.caption: TABLE PULSE turns heat into governed remote reaction packets.
scene_narration.narration: TABLE PULSE keeps pressure bounded: live heat, remote packets, opt-outs, and GM approval.

scene_narration.caption: BLACK LEDGER lets the world wake up after the run.
scene_narration.narration: BLACK LEDGER makes the city remember. Factions move, districts heat up, and new jobs emerge.

scene_narration.caption: Newsreels make consequences feel like the city is watching.
scene_narration.narration: Newsroom clips turn fallout into rumors, pressure, jokes, and hooks the GM can bring back to the table.

scene_narration.caption: COMMUNITY HUB brings players to vetted open runs.
scene_narration.narration: COMMUNITY HUB helps players find tables, pass preflight, schedule cleanly, and close the loop.

scene_narration.caption: Every Wonder returns to one table and one campaign.
scene_narration.narration: Every Wonder Horizon is the promise that the campaign can grow without losing the people, scenes, and choices that made it matter.
